working: Alumni eNews - July 2026 (sent 7/9) is still the best 2026 send: +77.2% traffic lift (14.5 to 25.7 daily sessions) with a 57.3% open rate. Alumni-oriented sends hold the top three 2026 lifts (+77.2%, +66.5% Staff-Client May, +65.2% Alumni Final Reminder June).
Open rates stay elite: 51.62% average across 100 campaigns (317,115 sends), roughly double the 25-35% health/nonprofit benchmark; July sends held it (Staff-Client 47.9%, Alumni 57.3%).
Organic Search is the only channel that grew since the 7/30 run (+29 sessions to 10,726) and holds 33.6% of the 31,959-session window mix.
Referring Partners eNews has the best engagement quality: 3.82-4.35% click-to-open on the June and July sends, tops among the lists despite a ~27% open rate.
not_working: UTM leakage is near-total: Email shows only 15 sessions in the whole GA4 window vs Direct's 16,193 (50.7%). The 7/20 sends logged 21 direct_sessions_3d vs 2 email_sessions_3d - GA4 is crediting newsletter clicks to Direct because links lack UTM tags.
Staff-Client eNews - July 2026 (7/20, biggest list at 8,906 sends) posted a -27.3% lift and 0.43% click rate, the weakest click of any 2026 send; the June edition (7/2) also went negative at -25.3%.
Average click rate is 1.94%, under the ~2-3% benchmark, and July sends ran 0.43-1.06% - strong opens are not converting to site visits.
GSC 7-day snapshot slipped vs the 7/30 run: clicks 24 to 17, impressions 3,138 to 1,658, impression-weighted position 16.8 to 19.4.
Organic Social is stuck at 5.4% of the mix (1,728 sessions), flat vs the prior run.
do_next: Add utm_source=constantcontact&utm_medium=email to every newsletter link before the next send; the ~20-50 direct_sessions_3d per send would then land in the Email channel and make lift attributable.
Repromote alumni-themed content and keep the main-send + reminder cadence; the 7/9 Thursday alumni send (+77.2%) beat both 7/20 Monday sends (-27.3%), so favor early-month Thursday sends.
Rework the Staff-Client eNews around its February 2026 formula (3.85% click, +45.9% lift) - the last three editions ran 0.43-0.81% clicks on the largest list.
Investigate the GSC slide (position 16.8 to 19.4, impressions nearly halved vs 7/30): check whether recently published location/counselor pages lost rankings or the tracked-keyword set changed.
summary: 31,959 sessions in the GA4 window with Direct at 50.7% and Organic Search at 33.6%; the 7/9 Alumni eNews still owns the year's best lift (+77.2%, 57.3% open), but untagged links keep crediting email traffic to Direct, the July Staff-Client sends went negative, and this week's GSC snapshot slipped.
